description: Splits Chinese text into words (longest match against the dictionary) and gives each its pinyin, Hán Việt per character, Vietnamese and English senses and entry `id`. `kind` is word, unknown (Chinese not in the dictionary: say so) or other (punctuation, Latin, digits). `otherReadings` > 0 means the word has more readings than the one shown: look it up when the reading matters. The split is by dictionary match, not grammar, and can be wrong (哪国人 comes out 哪 + 国人): check a split that changes the meaning.

text.description: Chinese text, up to 2000 characters: a sentence, a lesson's dialogue, a sign.

name: annotate_text
title: Annotate a Chinese text
